highlights.description: Initial release of web-tools monorepo with browser-based developer tools built as Lit Web Components
Three standalone tools: Markdown Editor, JWT Editor, and Coordinate Picker
Reusable site-nav component package for navigation, headers, badges, and theme toggle

added.description: Markdown Editor: Live preview with GitHub Flavored Markdown, syntax highlighting, and export options
JWT Editor: Decode, edit, and re-sign JWTs with support for HS256/HS384/HS512 algorithms
Coordinate Picker: Interactive map tool for selecting and managing geographic coordinates
site-nav package with wt-navbar, wt-header, wt-badge, wt-theme-toggle, wt-mega-menu, wt-mobile-menu components

documentation.description: Example HTML pages for each tool
MkDocs documentation site with Material theme
Guide for cleaning up coordinates in Coordinate Picker
site-nav component documentation with usage examples
Local development guide for working with unpublished packages

build.description: Gitignore for package-lock.json in library packages
